currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.20 HF2E real OCR size-prefix ordering verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 HF2E is merged and production verified. The previous HF2D sorter recognized explicit units such as 500ml but did not recognize the real printed-name convention used by OCR-confirmed products, such as 185ボス..., 240カン..., 270P..., 280P..., 380B..., and 600P.... Those products were therefore treated as unknown-size, so the intended maker → smaller container size → younger product number order was not actually being applied in real data. HF2E recognizes plausible leading 3–4 digit capacity prefixes while preserving explicit-unit parsing. PR #133 merged to main at 47ee4c4d38cc85c057ff3315f6dff40acdff7c92. PR browser regression run 35440464231 and main-push run 35440546492 passed all eight gates, including the new real-prefix gate; GitHub Pages deployment run 35440545590 and Vercel production status passed. App/engine/DB/schema remain FINAL.20 / AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Use VENDRIVE normally; no active feature phase is open.
Group product lists by maker first; maker-group order uses each maker's youngest natural product number.
Within a maker, sort known container sizes from smaller to larger before considering product number.
Recognize both explicit units such as 350ml/500ml and the real OCR printed-name prefix convention such as 185..., 240カン..., 270P..., 280P..., 380B..., and 600P....
When two products have the same detected size, sort by younger/natural product number.
Products whose size cannot be detected follow known-size products within the same maker.
Apply the same order to Product Master, Analysis > Inventory vehicle stock, and vehicle stocktake.
Use GitHub Actions + Playwright/Chromium as the standard deterministic browser regression path; the real-prefix ordering gate is part of the standard suite.
Keep inventory movement semantics, OCR/report confirmation boundaries, learned numeric forecasting, Analytics engine, DB and schema unchanged.
nextActions: Use the real app and visually confirm that OCR product names such as 185..., 240..., 270..., 280..., 380..., and 600... now appear in maker → smaller container size → younger product-number order.
Continue normal field evidence accumulation and classification confirmation where useful.
Reopen engineering only for new field friction or when the numeric promotion gate has enough evidence.
